purpose: Small exact-full-catalog captured-abundance comparator; combining with a state generator creates a modular predictor, not the original DDR reaction procedure
catalog: All ordered 26504 categories, including zero captured counts, RNA-unsupported categories, controls and unseen targets

source.features: 100 columns:48 source tanh-state means,48 variances,log(q0),log1p captured source count,log1p positive-RNA source count,positive-RNA availability indicator
source.missing_state: Zero summary placeholders plus an explicit absence indicator; these do not fabricate a state law. All categories remain in the normalizer and count loss.
source.scaling: Feature-wise mean/variance fitted across complete fitting catalogs with equal donor and equal category weights; exact constant columns receive unit scale
source.identity: No guide-specific trainable parameter. One target intercept only for non-control targets with positive captured source support in the fitting donors; unsupported and control intercepts are exactly zero.

model.normalization: Entire current-parameter catalog at every function and gradient evaluation; no inactive cache, minibatch-only denominator or probability floor
model.objective: Equal-donor mean complete-catalog cross-entropy plus lambda/2 * (sum beta^2 + sum_t (1+1/n_t)*intercept_t^2), where n_t is total captured Stim8hr support for that target across fitting donors
model.support_policy: n_t and intercept membership use source counts only, never endpoint support or outcome-based guide selection
model.fit_method: FP64 CPU L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient; zero initialization;500 iterations maximum,history10,25 line-search steps,12501 function-gradient evaluations maximum including final verification;ftol1e-12,gtol1e-8
model.convergence: Report convergence, iteration count, function evaluations and gradient norm. A finite500-iteration terminal result is explicitly budget-limited, not converged. Numerical or line-search failure does not trigger retries or fallback.

nested_selection.inner: Six fitting pairs times four strengths:24 small fits
nested_selection.outer_fits: One internally selected strength refitted per outer triple:4 fits
nested_selection.selection: Minimum equal-donor mean complete-catalog CE over exactly three permitted inner donors; exact ties choose stronger regularization
nested_selection.coverage: Same complete catalog/truth/representation/source and scoring identities across strengths; no state-paired subset for abundance
nested_selection.outer_access: Only source inputs before sealing the complete catalog forecast; outer counts used afterward for assessment, never penalty selection
nested_selection.other_channels: Report quadratic score and component provenance; this count-only comparator cannot enter the nine-channel selector by dropping its missing capabilities

remaining_before_execution: Exact source/count/catalog/representation input bindings and permissions
Actual optimizer numerical qualification without consuming an exhausted local disposable budget
Small-fit execution owner, CPU/RAM/output and aggregate function-evaluation admission
Complete forecast publication, release and modular-comparison bindings
scope: No new main configuration, no changes to the existing cached estimator, no automatic retries, no elapsed-time deadline. Local objective and analytic-gradient tests are not scientific fits.
